assessment: This manuscript presents an important mathematical analysis of metabolic "co-substrates" and how their cycling can affect metabolic fluxes. Through mathematical analysis of simple network motifs, it shows the impact of co-substrate cycling on constraining metabolic fluxes. The combination of mathematical modeling and comparisons with existing data from previous studies offers convincing support for the potential biological relevance of co-substrate cycling. The work will be of interest to researchers who study microbial metabolism and metabolic engineering.
